concerns: The update of the daily dispatch count (tgAccount.setDailyDispatchCount(tgAccount.getDailyDispatchCount() + 1)) is performed as a standard read-then-save rather than an atomic database increment. Although this is not a terminal status value transition (which would trigger a block verdict), a concurrent dispatch request could lead to a race condition where some dispatches are not counted correctly.

In DispatchService, when finding the candidate failover account, calling findByCampaignIdAndStatusIgnoreCaseOrderByIdAsc in a loop might load many candidate accounts, and then counting dispatches for each candidate in a loop (outboundDispatchRepository.countByTgAccountIdAndDispatchedAtAfter) could lead to an N+1 query pattern if there are many active accounts in the same campaign.
